turns.question: How much revenue did we make per site session between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-session metric, so I can't give that ratio; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) and Site sessions (and Average order value (EUR) for revenue per order): from 20 September to 3 October 2026, Revenue (EUR) was 7,172.59 EUR and Site sessions were 10.
